description: KineGate is an evidence gate for an issuer-specific tokenized-stock purchase. Its no-wallet fixture engine evaluates thirteen deterministic checks and creates an expiring SHA-256-bound local receipt. The observed-evidence workflow applies the same thirteen gate identities to recorded Binance quote, unsigned SWAP, failed prediction and pinned-block token reads; unknown current eligibility, clocks, balance, costs, spender and execution evidence remain explicit WAIT/BLOCK. It exports a non-executable REPLAY audit and invalidates that binding when intention, policy or source changes. Hashes establish internal integrity, not issuer authenticity. Authenticated RWA discovery, price, issuer profile and underlying-market calls succeeded for the current Ondo AAPLon representation; LiquidMesh returned a real 6-USDT SWAP quote. A controlled BSC eth_simulateV1 comparison used an identical payload and parent block: the 450,000 swap-gas limit failed; a bounded 1,183,991 limit succeeded and used 935,818 swap gas; changing the matching minimum word to twice the quote output failed. These are counterfactual simulations with a simulated exact approval, not approvals or purchases. The saved builder minimum fails the strict 0.5% cross-product policy because of floor rounding, and router/facet source and full ABI verification remain incomplete. No actual approval, wallet signature, broadcast or funds spent is claimed. The no-wallet product cannot sign or broadcast. Current public access is BLOCKED_BY_VISIBILITY_CHANGE: the repository is PRIVATE and GitHub Pages is disabled; previous deployment and release links are historical references pending a contest visibility decision. A later fresh0.49%builder request returned a minimum meeting the unchanged exact authorized0.5%cap. A second three-way native comparison again recorded FAILED/SUCCESS/FAILED; all six controlled samples are preserved. This resolves the authorized numerical bound for that counterfactual payload, while full facet verification, a fresh final review, personal signature and actual settlement remain incomplete.
